title: The Magic Story Shadows over Innistrad E-Book Collection
description: Whether you need to catch up on the story of Shadows over Innistrad or just want to read it all again, this e-book is for you!

paragraphs.text: Before we move into the story for Eldritch Moon (starting soon!), let's take a moment to reflect on the story of Shadows over Innistrad .

Good. Now that you're done reflecting, you might as well make sure you're all caught up on the story so far with our handy e-book collection below, filled with all the stories from Shadows over Innistrad .
The files below are in ePUB and mobi formats and require a compatible e-reader.
